title: Police explain the attacks as river miners with jetpacks

tellings.quote: They concluded that the villagers were being assaulted by river miners with jetpack technology.

related.note: This is the same 2023 Pintoyaku attacks as telling 8, but the police put them down to river miners with jetpacks rather than aliens.

plain: In 2023, police in the Peruvian village of San Antonio de Pintoyaku are said to have explained a string of attacks on villagers by blaming 'river miners with jetpack technology'. A guest named Tim Alberino, who went to look into the attacks, tells Michels this as what he heard from a woman named Talia. It is told to show how strange the official explanation for the attacks was.
